messages:
Marta: Quick heads-up — multiple pods reported A100 quota flapping in ap-northeast1 this morning. Saw our autoscaler hit quota error 409 during batch run. Anyone else seeing recent drops?
Devon: Yup saw it around 05:20 UTC, started failing _create instance_ with `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`. Scaling fallback kicked in to h100 pool.
Samir: Confirmed. Looks like vendor-side preemptible pool getting reclaimed. Metrics: 40% of requested A100s denied in last 30m. Raising a ticket with vendor-ops.
Vendor-Ops: We're on it. Vendor reports planned maintenance window extended unexpectedly in ap-northeast1, affecting a subset of A100 racks. ETA for resolution 2-3h. Will escalate to infra.
Marta: Thanks — can we get a quick policy for fallback? Prefer not to drop latency-critical hosted API.
Devon: Proposal: route traffic for inference-critical routes to eu-west1 A100 dedicated pool + enable temporary quantized H100 variant for lower-cost requests. I'll update routing policy canary.
Lucy: FYI I pushed a small change to routable config: `route_policy: prefer: eu-west1 if quota_failures > 5m` — see PR #422.
Samir: Also suggest enabling pre-warm of h100 nodes in ap-south1 for customer X. Cost is okay short-term. I'll ping sales for approval.
Vendor-Ops: Update: vendor will open 8 racks to us in next 90m as hotfix; still cleaning up firmware on rest. Will keep posting updates.
Cloud-Bot: Alert: quota event spike detected. Count: 12 quota_exceeded events in last 15m. Link: https://internal.metrics/redwood/quota-events/2123456789
Marta: Cool. Let's treat this as P1 for serving reliability. Devon/Samir — coordinate routing + pre-warm. Vendor-ops please add folks to the vendor ticket. I'll notify SRE.
Devon: On it. I'll start the canary switch (5% traffic) and monitor latency. Will post logs.
Samir: Pre-warm initiated for ap-south1 h100. Ticket #INFR-9087.
Vendor-Ops: Added contact list, escalation done. Will follow up when racks are live. :thumbsup:
Marta: Great, thanks everyone. Will close loop when stable.
